verses.text: Ex yinhtilal Benjamín, sayek b'aj tze kol he b'a. Elanhek t'a Jerusalén. Pu'ek k'e'en trompeta t'a Tecoa, ak'ekk'e te' tab' ch'oxnab'ilal t'a Bet-haquerem, yujto t'a norte skot jun niwan yahelal, niwan tas ol lajwokel yuj.
Toxo wal ol in satel heb' anima ay t'a Sion, heb' te nib'ab'il.
Ha heb' rey yet' heb' soldado ol jawok heb' t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol sb'o'an scampamento heb' t'a spatiktak. Ha b'aj ol kan junjun heb', ol satnhejel yuj heb'.
Ha heb' eyajk'ol chi', syal heb' icha tik: Kak'ek lista ko b'a kak'an owal yet'ok. Kotanhek, kak'ek owal yet' t'a chimk'uhalil. Palta anhej to wan yem k'u, wanxo yoch wewen,
yuj chi' t'ak'walil ol onh ochek kak' owal yet'ok. Ol ko mak'anem lanhnaj yet'tal heb' soldado stanhwan chonhab', xchi heb'.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ch'akekel te te', tze b'o'ank'e he tek'nub' yik tzex och eyak' owal t'a Jerusalén. Ol wak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab'il anima chi', yujto haxonhej ixtoj anima syak' heb'.
Ha t'a Jerusalén chi' spak'cha'anh chukal, icha wal sk'e'ul sjaj junok ha ha'. Anhej ixtoj anima yet' chukal sb'inaj t'ay. Yuj chi' ol janhej yahelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi'.
B'o'ek he b'eyb'al ex aj Jerusalén, yik wach' max wik'el in pensar t'ayex. Tato ma'ay, ol wak'kan tzinan he lu'um tik, manhxalaj mach ol kajnajkan t'ay, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' israel tik manhxa junok heb' ol kanok, icha tz'aj smolchaj sat te' uwa manhxa b'aj skan junok pitanh sat, icha chi' ol aj heb'. Yuj chi' yakb'an manto uji jun chi', kolkanel jantak heb' syal yelkani, icha wal tz'aj yek' heb' swach' molan te' sat uwa t'a sk'ab', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in tak'wi: ¿Mamin, mach ol ab'anok tato swal jun ab'ix tik? Icha wal to makan schikin heb', max yab'laj heb'. Tonhej sb'uchwaj heb', max schalaj sk'ol a lolonel heb'.

Mamin, skot pax yowal in k'ol het'ok t'a jun chonhab' tik. Maxtzak techaj wuj in yamanoch wa'an, xin chi. Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Hak'em yowal in k'ol chi' t'a yib'anh heb' unin tzek' t'a yoltak calle yet' t'a yib'anh heb' winh kelemtak umanek'i. Ol yamchaj heb' winh winak yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' te icham animaxo.
Masanil spat heb', smunlajel heb', heb' ix yetb'eyum heb', ch'okxo mach ol ik'ankanok. Yujto a in wal Jehová in swala', ol wik'k'e in k'ab' wak'an syahelal heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik.

Masanil heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, anhej tas syutej heb' yak'an ganar t'a spatik chukal sna'a. Hanheja' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' sacerdote, haxonhej elk'al syak' heb'.
Snib'ej heb' sk'ub'ejel jantak yahelal syab' in chonhab', syalan heb' to ay junk'olal, palta manh yeloklaj.

Max k'ixwi jab'ok heb' sk'ulan juntzanh tas max techaj wilani. Malaj jab'ok sk'ixwelal heb', manh yojtakok heb' tas jun k'ixwelal chi'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', a wal yik ol wak'an syahelal heb', ol satkanel heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a heb' schonhab' icha tik: Ayik ex och tek'tek' b'aj skulusej sb'a b'e, ix walan t'ayex: Scham wal eyilan b'aj tzex b'ati. Tze k'anb'ej eyab'i tas b'e'al yik'nak heb' he mam eyicham. Haton t'a b'e wach' chi' tzex b'ati, hata' ol eyik' eyip, xin chi t'ayex. Palta ix eyalani: Ma'ay, malaj ko gana tzonh b'at ta', xe chi.

Icha spukhaj k'e'en trompeta yik syak'an ab'ix to wan sjawi owal t'a skal heb' anima, icha chi' ix wutej in chekanb'at heb' in chekab' ex skacha', ix in chekan yal heb' icha tik: Aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al tik, yik manh ol ja yahelal t'a eyib'anh, xin chi. Palta ix eyalan icha tik: Malaj ko gana skaktejkani, xe chi.
Yuj chi' swalan icha tik: Ab'ek ex ch'ok chonhab'il, ojtakejekel tas ol ujok t'a in chonhab' tik.

Ab'ek he masanil ex kajan ex t'a sat lu'um tik: Ol wik'kot junok yahelal te chuk t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, yuj chukal sna heb' sk'ulej, yujto maj scha yab' in lolonel heb', ix spatikejel in k'ayb'ub'al heb'.

Ex in chonhab', ¿tasto yuj tzeyik'kot incienso yik chonhab' Sabá t'ayin yet' te te' suk'uk'i sjab' skot t'a juntzanh chonhab' najat? Maxtzak schalaj in k'ol juntzanh he silab' tze nhustz'a'ok, ma juntzanhxo he silab' tzeyak'a', xchi Jehová.

Yuj juntzanh tik ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ol wak'em junok tas b'aj ol slok sb'a eyok t'a yichanh heb' eyajk'o'ol. Eb' mamab'il, heb' uninab'il, heb' kajan t'a slak'anil heb' yet' heb' yamigo heb', lajannhej ol aj scham heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Hato t'a snajatil lum lum ay t'a stojolal norte, hata' ay jun chonhab' te ay yip wan yak'an lista sb'a skoti.

Yet'nak sjul-lab' heb' yet' slanza. Te chuk heb', malaj yok'elk'olal heb'. Icha wal sk'anh sk'e wa'an ha' mar, icha wal chi' yel yaw heb' skoti, ayk'e heb' t'a yib'anh chej. Listaxo yaj heb' skot yak' owal heyet'ok a ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' anima t'a Jerusalén tik, ol yal heb' icha tik: Toxo ix kab' jun ab'ix chi', ix el kip yuj xiwelal. Te ya skab'i, icha wal yab'an sya'il junok ix ix ayik tz'alji yune'.
Manhxo ex b'at munlajel, manhxo ex b'eyek' t'a yoltak b'e, yujto te ay xiwk'olal. Yalxonhej b'aj ayek' heb' ajk'o'ol yet' syamk'ab' yik owal, xcham heb' anima chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a schonhab' icha tik: Ex in chonhab', ak'ekoch pichul ya swa'i yik tze ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Ek'anhek b'alb'on t'a skal k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh. Ochanhek wal t'a kusk'olal, ok'anhek wal sik'lab'il, icha wal yik scham junok k'otanh eyuninal, yujto a jun mach ol ex satanelok, wan sja tzak'najok, xchi.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tzach wak'ochi yik tzak'an prowal in chonhab' tik. Tza ch'olb'itej wal heb' sik'lab'il, tzilan wal tas yaj sb'eyb'al heb'.
Te pit heb' smasanil, alum pekal heb'. Ix pitb'i'el spixan heb' icha stzatzil k'e'en bronce, ma k'e'en hierro.

Ayik slawaj te' k'ak' yet' junok lawlab', schakb'i te', tz'ulaxel k'e'en plomo t'a skal k'e'en plata. Palta haxo in chonhab' tik, wach'chom ix wak'lej in b'o'an sb'eyb'al heb', palta malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi, yujto malaj jab'ok swach'il sb'eyb'al heb', max satel chukal t'a skal heb'.
Yuj chi' ol aljok yuj heb' to lajan heb' icha schukal k'e'en plata sjulchajeli, yujto a in Jehová in tik, ix in spatikejel heb', xchi Jehová.
